prerequisite: Release 1.33 merged (T&M Work Orders + Equipment Financial Layer + LEM Foundation)

hamburgers.title: TTC-1: Labor Bill Generator
hamburgers.description: One-click invoice from approved timesheets. New Generate Labor Bill button on Job Invoicing tab opens a modal with period range, grouping (per user / trade level / role / total), live preview pulling hours from approved TimeSheetDetailRecords priced via LEM-1 billableValue. Creates a Simple JobBill with lines linked back to source timesheet entries.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate Labor Bill button appears on Job Invoicing tab for users with jobBill.create
Modal supports per-user, per-trade-level, per-role, and one-total grouping
Preview refreshes within 1 second on a 500-line timesheet job
Only approved timesheet entries on the selected job in the period are included
Lines with no billable rate use cost x markup fallback with a yellow warning
Generated bill opens in standard Bill flyout, fully editable
Re-generating skips timesheet entries already linked to a non-deleted bill
Deleting a generated bill releases timesheet entries for re-billing

hamburgers.title: TTC-2: Send Invoice via Email
hamburgers.description: One-click email send for any JobBill. Send button on bill flyout opens a modal pre-filled with the Job's primary billing contact, subject template, body (uses TTC-3 cover letter if assigned), and the freshly-rendered invoice PDF. New JobBillEmailRecord model captures the audit trail; Mailgun webhooks update delivered/opened/bounced state. Auto-flips bill status to Sent. Closes Q21030-7709.
acceptanceCriteria: Send button on bill flyout for users with jobBill.send permission
Send modal pre-fills To from Job's primary billing contact
PDF rendered fresh at send time and auto-attached
On successful send, bill flips to Sent and Send Activity entry appears immediately
Mailgun webhooks update activity to Delivered / Opened / Bounced as events arrive
Bounced sends show a banner with one-click Resend
Send history is per-bill and never deleted (audit trail)

hamburgers.title: TTC-3: Invoice Cover Letter Templates
hamburgers.description: New DocumentTemplate kind for invoice transmittal letters. ~12 invoice merge tags (invoiceNumber, amount, dueDate, periodStart/End, customer, contact, jobNumber, sender, instance, PO). Per-customer default via Company.defaultInvoiceCoverLetterTemplateId, with instance-level fallback. TTC-2 Send modal auto-resolves the cascade and pre-fills the body.
acceptanceCriteria: Invoice Cover Letters tab on Settings -> Document Templates
Editor supports rich-text body and merge-tag chip insertion
Preview against any real bill renders merged HTML correctly
Customer detail page lets admin assign a default cover letter
TTC-2 Send modal pre-fills body via cascade resolution (customer -> instance -> none)
Missing merge tag values render empty (no error in production sends)
New instances seeded with built-in Standard Transmittal template

hamburgers.title: TTC-4: A/R Reminder Engine
hamburgers.description: Configurable reminder schedules per customer (e.g. +7 friendly / +14 second / +30 final past due). Daily processor (driven by external scheduled trigger) finds eligible bills and fires reminders via the TTC-2 send pipeline using TTC-3 templates. Per-bill suppression toggle, weekly admin digest, full timeline panel on bill flyout. Idempotency guarantee on (jobBillId, ruleId).
acceptanceCriteria: Settings -> A/R Reminders page for users with jobBillReminder.configure
Schedule definition: name + ordered list of (offsetDays, tone, templateId)
Customer detail page assigns one schedule (or no reminders)
Daily processor (external scheduled trigger) is idempotent on (jobBillId, ruleId)
Reminders auto-stop on Paid bills
Per-bill Pause Reminders toggle stops further reminders for that bill
Today's Reminders admin page lists firing today/this week with skip actions
Weekly digest email summarizes reminders sent + still overdue + bills missing due dates

hamburgers.title: TTC-5: LEM Combined Report
hamburgers.description: Single page at /reports/lem-combined showing Labor / Equipment / Material side-by-side as cost vs billable, by job or cost code, drillable to source records. Phase 1 ships Labor + Equipment standalone (LEM-1/2 already in QA). Phase 2 adds Material columns when MAT-2a lands. Closes Q21030-7740 (Job Labour Report) and Thomas's canonical LEM ask.
acceptanceCriteria: /reports/lem-combined page exists for users with report.lemCombined.view
Filter bar: Job multi-select, Period (this/last/custom), Group By (Cost Code / Job), Include toggles
Numbers tie out exactly to FinancialSummaryFeed for cost-side and LEM-1/2 for billable-side
Margin % cells color-coded green / yellow / red with instance-configurable thresholds
Cell-level drill-down lists source records (timesheets, equipment time entries)
Excel export produces a single sheet with all visible rows + columns + totals
Loads in <= 3 seconds on a 5,000-timesheet job
Material columns enable in Phase 2 when MAT-2a is live for the instance
